---
format: docx
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false
h_plot <- knitr::knit_hooks$get("plot")
h_chunk <- knitr::knit_hooks$get("chunk")
lines <- c(
  paste("pandoc.to=", knitr::opts_knit$get("rmarkdown.pandoc.to")),
  paste("pandoc.from=", knitr::opts_knit$get("rmarkdown.pandoc.from")),
  paste("pandoc.args=", paste(knitr::opts_knit$get("rmarkdown.pandoc.args"), collapse = " ")),
  paste("pandoc_to()=", knitr::pandoc_to()),
  paste("is_latex_output()=", knitr::is_latex_output()),
  paste("quarto.version=", knitr::opts_knit$get("quarto.version")),
  paste("runtime=", knitr::opts_knit$get("rmarkdown.runtime")),
  paste("plot hook is Quarto's (cell-output-display in body)=",
        any(grepl("cell-output-display", deparse(h_plot), fixed = TRUE))),
  paste("chunk hook is Quarto's (delegating: calls default hook)=",
        any(grepl("default_hooks", deparse(h_chunk), fixed = TRUE)) || any(grepl("hook\\(x, options\\)", deparse(h_chunk)))),
  paste("opts_hooks present at setup time=", paste(sort(names(knitr::opts_hooks$get())), collapse = ","))
)
writeLines(lines, "probe.txt")
```
